description: Fetch, validate, and import a recipe or recipe-bundle JSON from an HTTPS URL into a local recipes directory (host-allowlisted, size-capped).

max_bytes.description: Maximum download size in bytes (default 1 MiB, hard cap 10 MiB).

out_dir.description: Recipe directory to write imported recipes into.

url.description: HTTPS URL of a recipe or recipe-bundle JSON (e.g. a git-raw link).

name: import_recipe_from_url
title: Import recipe from URL
